mechanics.claim: Basic attacks against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark, dealing the mark's bonus physical damage.
mechanics.quote: His {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark

mechanics.claim: The mark's damage procs as a separate damage instance in sequence after the basic attack, which can trigger on-hit-adjacent effects an extra time.
mechanics.quote: The mark deals {{tip|proc damage}} in sequence after the basic attack.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the mark's application, but not the mark's consumption from an attack.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the mark's application, but not the mark's consumption from an attack.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack can be dodged, blocked, or missed while blinded, in which case the mark is not consumed.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, and missed while {{tip|blind|blinded}} but the mark will not be consumed.

mechanics.claim: Starting the empowered attack while the mark is about to expire does not extend the mark, but the attack still completes and deals its bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: Starting the empowered attack while the mark is about to time out will not extend the mark duration, but still complete the attack and apply the bonus damage.

mechanics.claim: All Out's bonus damage on abilities that hit multiple enemies only applies to the first target hit.
mechanics.quote: All Out's bonus damage on abilities only applies to the first target hit when damaging multiple enemies (including minions and monsters).

mechanics.claim: All Out's bonus damage amplifies the existing damage instance rather than applying as a separate extra damage instance, so it does not trigger effects an extra time.
mechanics.quote: All Out's bonus damage amps the benefiting damage instance without applying an extra damage instance.
